text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the Trainer and Biwa 
Hayahide head to the training track to 
apply today's practical race data into 
their "theory."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin were 
there, inspired by today's race to train 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that spirited run, Biwa Hayahide 
realizes anew that facing the two of them 
is an unavoidable path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be ready to face her younger sister, 
she first had to seize the top of her 
generation. Her next target was decided: 
the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown.
